name: Kuntza
source:
A maid with elf ears who works as the receptionist at Aruji's inn.

She is also a member of "Pisolino Corvo", and was assigned to the abandoned inn on a mission of her own. She's a mysterious girl who doesn't speak much and whose face lacks expression, so it's hard to tell what she's thinking. When she does speak, she has a sharp tongue.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character03.php]official website[/url]]
